long_biography.plain_text:
After leaving school to serve in the United States Marine Corps, Dave Hurley returned from Vietnam in 1968 and worked in an Illinois rock quarry. A cookware demonstration at the farmhouse he rented with his wife drew him into commission sales. Hurley eventually became West Bend's largest cookware distributor, recruiting thousands of student salespeople and creating a live demonstration used at events across the United States.

Advanced Marketing became the owner-controlled company through which Hurley sold Kitchen Craft and Lustre Craft cookware. When West Bend's appliance production moved overseas, the Hurley family invested in a new Wisconsin factory, Americraft; Hurley's son Bryan led manufacturing while Dave remained focused on sales. His interests also include Peter Pan Properties, a Mount Dora leasing and commercial-property business.
long_biography.html:
After leaving school to serve in the United States Marine Corps, Dave Hurley returned from Vietnam in 1968 and worked in an Illinois rock quarry. Advanced Marketing became the owner-controlled company through which Hurley sold Kitchen Craft and Lustre Craft cookware. When West Bend's appliance production moved overseas, the Hurley family invested in a new Wisconsin factory, Americraft; Hurley's son Bryan led manufacturing while Dave remained focused on sales. His interests also include Peter Pan Properties, a Mount Dora leasing and commercial-property business.
